notes: Generated by `go run ./cmd/hubhop gen` from the MobiFlight HubHop community database. The selector and the bindings have not been confirmed in the simulator: treat this as a starting point, and correct it in place once flown. Every binding falls back to the stock variable, and a local variable the aircraft does not define is withheld rather than read as zero, so a wrong name costs nothing.
